positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Engineering · TypeScript · Python (Programming Language) · PostgreSQL · Large Language Models (LLM)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Docker Products · Computer Vision · Python (Programming Language) · TypeScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · MongoDB · Next.js

positions.title: Student at Flat Iron School
positions.description: Completed 15-week program to learn full-stack web development and software engineering practices. Collaborated in teams to generate projects end-to-end and created multiple solo full stack web apps.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · JavaScript · React.js · Ruby on Rails

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Edited video of events and showcases for the archive and generated multi-platform graphics for marketing of new courses. Conducted interviews with avant-garde new media artists for the Gray Area blog. Participated in the 2021 Gray Area Artist Showcase.
positions.insights: Skills: Graphic Design · Marketing · Adobe Premiere Pro

positions.title: Associate Product Manager
positions.description:
As an associate product manage I worked closely with the head of product, design teams, front end and back end developer, and the marketing team to launch our application on three platforms: iOS, Android, and Web.

(Pixvana and Voodle are composed of the same team which pivoted products and re-branded.)

positions.title: Product Management & Video Production & Sales Engineer
positions.description: Pixvana was a b2b Virtual Reality software platform that enables users to upload and edit 8k 360 degree interactive video experiences to use in training and onboarding. I generated sales enablement content, which included static video production and dynamic VR in-headset experiences

positions.title: Publisher
positions.description: The Whitman Wire is an entirely student run organization that prints a weekly newspaper for the student community of 1,600. As publisher I managed the $50,000 production budget to pay the 60+ all-student staff. During my tenure as publisher I implemented Slack for the editorial board, created a new Web Editor position for further online engagement, and alongside the student government I doubled the newspaper’s 2018-19 budget to pay Wire staff minimum wage continuing the effort of the previous Publisher & EIC.
positions.insights: Skills: Journalism · Operations Management · Online Journalism

positions.title: Photography and Project Assistant
positions.description: The Walla Walla Foundry is a renowned producer of fine art sculpture for artists such as Yayoi Kusama, Paul McCarthy, and Jeff Koons. I photographed and videotaped the foundry’s 100+ simultaneous projects for artist proofs, internal documentation, and website display. I put my hands to work in the molding and casting room on months long collaborative efforts. On my own accord I made a documentary about the foundry which was well received.

positions.title: Associate Producer
positions.description: Hosted by Mythbuster's Adam Savage, Tested.com is a 4million+ subscriber YouTube channel that covers technology news and maker culture. My position there was as a summer intern where I produced 15+ videos.

positions.title: Photography and Video Editor
positions.description: Responsible for directing team meetings and arranging assignments for photographers and videographers of the newspaper team. Also partake in editors meetings where the direction of the entire newspaper is discussed.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Worked alongside the marketing branch to produce educational videos to educate schools and larger organizations about safe drone use and the benefit of drones in enforcing public safety. I shot videos on-location and edited them in post-production.

honors.title: Whitman College Hosokawa Journalism Award
honors.description:
Quoted from Whitman College's website:
"In 2000, an endowed lectureship was established at Whitman College by David and Beverly Hosokawa, and the Hosokawa Family Foundation. Intended to be a celebration of journalistic excellence, the lectureship honors Robert R. Hosokawa, David’s father, by bringing a noted journalist to campus. The endowment also established the Hosokawa Prize to be awarded each year in recognition of outstanding achievement and excellence as demonstrated by student journalists and photojournalists of The Pioneer."

https://www.whitman.edu/communications/the-hosokawa-journalism-endowment

honors.title: Stephen B.L. Penrose Scholarship
honors.description: "Stephen B.L. Penrose Scholarships are merit-based scholarships awarded to entering students who have achieved high academic excellence in their college preparatory work" (whitman.edu).
